ruled_order: Curly-double-quoted spans that are not WEB text: (i) the orchestrator's deterministic sweep, run over the chain head after CWO-EZ-13 and before the fix-up orders are built, tests each such span with ezek_lib.web_quote_found against the whole WEB text (Ezek_web_clean.txt, all 1,273 verses); a span found nowhere in the WEB is a gloss and its U+201C/U+201D pair is replaced by ASCII single quotes (or by U+2018/U+2019 when the span itself contains an ASCII apostrophe), with old and new bytes per change in the manifest; (ii) a span found verbatim in the WEB is a WEB quotation lacking its ref and becomes an item for its part's FIXUP-1 author under this id (add the inline web: ref, or drop the quotation). Coverage: check_web_quotes' class 'curly quote with NO web: ref in its field' reads 0 over the applied rows, recorded as CWO-EZ-18.json with the sweep manifest and the carrying execution ids.
ruled_predicate: every curly-double-quoted span in a prose field that check_web_quotes classes 'curly quote with NO web: ref in its field' on the chain head (S1's count: 134 spans across 40 rows in p02, p08, p09 and others); all parts.
